They may be faster, but cliff units can easily stop them dead in their tracks.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 5 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Wasterunner''', internally referred to as '''Mutated Speedy''', name that is still used for its legacy version, is a fast enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has high health and a fast speed. The '''Wasterunner''' could have been spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. ==Appearance== The '''Wasterunner''' has a dark teal skin color, with a dark navy torso and legs. Violet veins can be seen on its head and arms. It emits light green particles and is faceless. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |4.25 |- !Wave !Health |- |2 |89 |- |3 |94 |- |4 |98 |- |5 |102 |- |6 |106 |- |7 |111 |- |8 |115 |- |9 |119 |- |10 |123 |- |11 |128 |- |12 |132 |- |13 |136 |- |14 |140 |- |15 |145 |- |16 |149 |- |17 |153 |- |18 |157 |- |19 |162 |- |20 |166 |- |21 |170 |- |22 |174 |- |23 |179 |- |24 |183 |- |25 |187 |} ==Strategy== *As [[Polluted Wasteland II]] has the [[HP Locked]] modifier and the '''Wasterunner''' has quite high health, it is not possible to let even a single wave of '''Wasterunners''' reach the exit. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Engineer]] or [[Mortar]] can clear it out quite easily. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMutatedSpeedy.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Wasterunner''' in the game trailers. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMutatedSpeedy.png|'''Wasterunner''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Despite having replaced the [[Quick]], this enemy was once named ''Mutated Speedy'' and not ''Mutated Quick''. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' -
